avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may reduce hydromorphone concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, monitor for reduced analgesia and adjust dosing

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Hepatotoxicity risk and potential CNS depression potentiation

avoid_supplements.name: Valerian Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression increasing risk of respiratory depression and sedation
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; counsel patient on risks of combined sedating effects

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may marginally increase hydromorphone levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased opioid effects; generally safe but advise patient

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium
caution_supplements.mechanism: High-dose magnesium may enhance CNS depression
caution_supplements.action: Use at standard supplemental doses; monitor if high-dose use is considered

caution_supplements.name: Melatonin
caution_supplements.action: Educate patient on cumulative sedative effects; use lowest effective dose

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases hydromorphone bioavailability and plasma concentrations, elevating overdose and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate grapefruit consumption entirely during hydromorphone therapy

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay hydromorphone absorption and peak levels; affects medication timing predictability
caution_foods.action: Counsel patient to take consistently with or without food; maintain dietary consistency

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression, respiratory depression, and increased overdose risk even at moderate doses
caution_foods.action: Strongly advise patient to avoid or minimize alcohol; educate on cumulative dangers

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of respiratory depression, excessive sedation, and opioid toxicity, particularly if CYP3A4 inhibitors or CNS depressants are introduced. Counsel patients to report use of all supplements and maintain consistent dietary patterns to ensure stable drug levels and therapeutic outcomes.
